# DRAFT — Evidence Intents Extracted from LAW-005

## Notes on routing and scope

This passage is a Mexican tax-administration disposition (Acuerdo 173/2022) issued by the Secretaría de Hacienda y Crédito Público (SHCP) via its Unidad de Política de Ingresos No Tributarios. It sets the IEPS fuel-tax stimulus percentages, per-liter fiscal stimulus amounts, reduced IEPS rates per liter, and complementary per-liter stimulus amounts for the period 10–16 December 2022.

Because the disposition is technical, fiscal-rule content, it is most directly mappable to ruler-quality questions about (a) enacting and administering credible fiscal/tax rules that protect macroeconomic stability (5B.3), (b) producing a sufficiently clear formal program with enacted schedules (8B.1, 8B.2, 8B.6), and (c) administrative coordination/mobilization across implementing units (8B.3, 8B.5). It also bears indirectly on distributional welfare policy through fuel prices (6B.2, 6B.7) and on social-shock response (6B.6). No content addresses political rights, integrity self-dealing, peace, domestic violence, or nuclear risk. I am not asserting that the absence of these topics is a finding — only that no intent in the text supports claims in those chapters.

I treat the two HTML blocks as contiguous and the segments as the narrowest range needed per claim. Where a claim's support is non-contiguous (e.g., percentage and amount come from different articles), I split it into two intents with their own locator/segment ranges.

---

## D0001 — Issuer, legal basis, and effective period of Acuerdo 173/2022

- **Question IDs:** 5B.3 (primary); 8B.1, 8B.2 (secondary)
- **Polarity:** positive (formal, rule-based fiscal action within established legal authority)
- **Period fit:** period-of-record (10–16 December 2022); published in the Diario Oficial de la Federación
- **Actor:** KARINA RAMÍREZ ARRAS, Titular de la Unidad de Política de Ingresos No Tributarios, Secretaría de Hacienda y Crédito Público (acting in suplencia of the Subsecretario de Hacienda y Crédito Público)
- **Mechanism:** Executive-branch Acuerdo issued under two named Decretos (the 27 December 2016 IEPS stimulus Decreto and the 4 March 2022 complementary fuel stimulus Decreto)
- **Outcome:** Formal fiscal-rule schedule for one week
- **Limitations:** Single-week period; no information here on cumulative effect, distribution, or downstream consumer prices
- **Source:** LAW-005 (sidof.segob.gob.mx)
- **Locator / segments (extracted HTML block 1):** S00005 → S00011
  - S00005 (676–854): designation as Acuerdo 173/2022
  - S00006 (854–981): subject of the Acuerdo
  - S00007 (981–1111): issuing official's name, title, and unit
  - S00008 (1111–1331): first legal basis (Decreto of 27 December 2016)
  - S00009 (1331–1567): second legal basis (Decreto of 4 March 2022)
  - S00010 (1567–1780): action verb — "se dan a conocer los porcentajes…"
  - S00011 (1780–1998): specified period (10–16 December 2022) and entry into the Acuerdo body

## D0002 — IEPS fuel-tax stimulus percentages by fuel type (10–16 December 2022)

- **Question IDs:** 5B.3 (primary); 6B.2 (secondary, via consumer price effect)
- **Polarity:** positive (enacted and published tax schedule)
- **Period fit:** exact 10–16 December 2022 window
- **Actor:** SHCP via Unidad de Política de Ingresos No Tributarios
- **Mechanism:** Article Primero fixes the percentage of fiscal stimulus for the period by fuel category
- **Outcome:** Three published percentages — Gasolina menor a 91 octanos 26.96%; Gasolina mayor o igual a 91 octanos y combustibles no fósiles 0.00%; Diésel 59.77%
- **Limitations:** Percent only; no accompanying peso figures in this segment
- **Source:** LAW-005
- **Locator / segments (extracted HTML block 2):** S00001 (0–152) — only S00001; S00002 belongs to Article Segundo (amounts) and is not needed for the percentage claim
- **Inspect:** S00001 exactly once

## D0003 — Per-liter fiscal stimulus amounts in pesos (10–16 December 2022)

- **Question IDs:** 5B.3 (primary); 8B.2, 8B.6 (secondary)
- **Polarity:** positive (enacted and quantified)
- **Period fit:** exact 10–16 December 2022 window
- **Actor:** SHCP via Unidad de Política de Ingresos No Tributarios
- **Mechanism:** Article Segundo fixes the per-liter fiscal stimulus amount by fuel category
- **Outcome:** Three published per-liter amounts — Gasolina menor a 91 octanos $1.4803; Gasolina mayor o igual a 91 octanos y combustibles no fósiles $0.0000; Diésel $3.6071 (pesos/litro)
- **Limitations:** Per-liter peso amount, not the IEPS base rate; no incidence data on consumers, transport, or agricultural users
- **Source:** LAW-005
- **Locator / segments (extracted HTML block 2):** S00002 (152–379) and S00003 (379–500)
  - S00002 introduces the Article Segundo table header
  - S00003 contains the three peso-per-liter values
  - The two are non-contiguous in support terms (intro line vs. data line) but both are within the same Article; the narrowest contiguous range that fully supports the claim is S00002–S00003

## D0004 — Reduced IEPS rates per liter (cuotas disminuidas) (10–16 December 2022)

- **Question IDs:** 5B.3 (primary); 8B.2, 8B.6 (secondary)
- **Polarity:** positive (enacted and quantified)
- **Period fit:** exact 10–16 December 2022 window
- **Actor:** SHCP via Unidad de Política de Ingresos No Tributarios
- **Mechanism:** Article Tercero fixes the reduced IEPS rate per liter (cuota) by fuel category
- **Outcome:** Three published per-liter rates — Gasolina menor a 91 octanos $4.0114; Gasolina mayor o igual a 91 octanos y combustibles no fósiles $4.6375; Diésel $2.4283 (pesos/litro)
- **Limitations:** Rate not yet combined with the percentage; no consumer-price impact calculation in this text
- **Source:** LAW-005
- **Locator / segments (extracted HTML block 2):** S00004 (500–723) and S00005 (723–963)
  - S00004 opens the Article Tercero table
  - S00005 carries the first two fuel rows and the lead-in to Article Cuarto
  - This pair is the narrowest contiguous range that fully supports the three-row claim

## D0005 — Complementary per-liter fuel stimulus amounts (10–16 December 2022)

- **Question IDs:** 5B.3 (primary); 6B.2, 6B.6 (secondary, as a shock-mitigation lever in a high-price window)
- **Polarity:** neutral as a fiscal instrument (published value is zero across all three categories); informational for calibration only
- **Period fit:** exact 10–16 December 2022 window
- **Actor:** SHCP via Unidad de Política de Ingresos No Tributarios
- **Mechanism:** Article Cuarto fixes the per-liter complementary stimulus amount
- **Outcome:** All three complementary amounts are set to $0.0000 pesos/litro (Gasolina menor a 91 octanos; Gasolina mayor o igual a 91 octanos y combustibles no fósiles; Diésel)
- **Limitations:** A zero value here is itself the substantive fact; absence of complementary stimulus is not absence of the principal IEPS stimulus
- **Source:** LAW-005
- **Locator / segments (extracted HTML block 2):** S00005 (723–963) tail and S00006 (963–1168)
  - S00005 carries the Article Cuarto lead-in
  - S00006 contains the table header and the three zero values
  - The narrowest contiguous range that fully supports the three-row zero claim is S00005–S00006

## D0006 — Entry into force and signing/issuance metadata

- **Question IDs:** 8B.1, 8B.2, 8B.5 (primary); 5B.3 (secondary)
- **Polarity:** positive (timely, traceable administrative act)
- **Period fit:** issuance 08 December 2022, Ciudad de México; entry into force the day after publication in the Diario Oficial de la Federación
- **Actor:** KARINA RAMÍREZ ARRAS, in suplencia of the Subsecretario de Hacienda y Crédito Público
- **Mechanism:** Transitorio Único fixes entry into force; signature line records issuing authority and date
- **Outcome:** Single-week rule is in force beginning the day after DOF publication; rubric recorded
- **Limitations:** No publication date is given inside the document text itself (the registry field is "unknown_not_recorded"); the 08 December 2022 signature date is the only dated anchor in the disposition
- **Source:** LAW-005
- **Locator / segments (extracted HTML block 2):** S00007 (1168–1299), S00008 (1299–1535), S00009 (1535–1727), S00010 (1727–1870)
  - S00007 sets the entry-into-force rule
  - S00008 records the Ciudad de México, 08 de diciembre de 2022 issuance line
  - S00009 carries the second legal-basis reference and the in-suplencia recital
  - S00010 names the signing official, her title, and the rubric
  - The narrowest contiguous range that fully supports the entry-into-force + signature/issuance claim is S00007–S00010

---

## Locator disposition summary

Each locator is named exactly once across all intents. Contiguous ranges that fully support a claim are kept together; non-contiguous supports (Article Primero percentages vs. Article Segundo amounts vs. Article Tercero rates vs. Article Cuarto complementaries) are separated into distinct intents so the segment ranges are narrow and the quotation copy is precise.

No quotation text is reproduced in any semantic field. Draft IDs D0001–D0006 are sequential within this response.
